LESSON: ESTABLISHING AGRICULTURAL ENTERPRISE

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE
Strand: Agricultural Technologies and Entrepreneurship
Topic 3.3: Establishing Agricultural Enterprise
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 13

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Establishing Agricultural Enterprise, part of Agricultural Technologies and Entrepreneurship in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE.

Key inquiry question: How do we establish an agricultural enterprise? 2. How does technology enhance the efficiency of the factors of production in agriculture?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Establishing Agricultural Enterprise together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: Learner develops self-awareness and planning skills when demonstrating how to prepare vegetable

crop produce for marketing and display produce to the class.

● Communication and collaboration: learner develops effective writing skills when demonstrating how to prepare

(through branding and labelling) and display agriculture produce for marketing.

61

Values

● Integrity: learner develops honesty by demonstrating proper sorting and grading, weighing, labelling, branding and

fair pricing when marketing agricultural produce and observing ethics when using online marketing platforms.

● Respect: as a learner uses courteous words when inquiring about expenses incurred in marketing activities from a

resource person.

Values:
● Integrity: learner develops honesty when discussing legal or acceptable ways of mobilising capital to establish an

agricultural enterprise.

58

● Respect: learner understands and appreciates others when discussing and making presentations on factors of

production in an agricultural enterprise.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Financial literacy: learner develops investment skills when discussing with a resource person ways of mobilizing

capital for establishing agricultural enterprise.

● Consumer education: learner develops consumer awareness when evaluating various ways of mobilising capital to

establish an agricultural enterprise, for example, importance of reading carefully terms and conditions of loan

agreements from financial institutions to understand their obligations.

Suggested learning resources:

• Digital devices with assistive technology

• Print materials

• Braille materials

• Established enterprises in school or its environs

• Resource person

Suggested Key Skills

Analyse ways of acquiring capital to establish an agricultural enterprise.
